area.policy: Quote directly measured surface in M2.
area.alternative: Review a fixed piece or length product separately.
area.risk: No width or area-to-length conversion is assumed.

bulk.policy: Quote the named bulk material by net mass.
bulk.alternative: Defer counted packs or surface-priced forms to a separate review.
bulk.risk: Grade, density, trade units and pack contents stay unspecified.

equipment.alternative: Defer any assembly requiring fitment specifications.
equipment.risk: Compatibility and certification are outside the synthetic scope.

length.policy: Quote supplied linear length in M.
length.alternative: Review a fixed finished item as its own proposed form.
length.risk: No count, diameter, width, certification, or mass conversion is claimed.

liquids.policy: Select one explicitly liquid form with L/ML.
liquids.alternative: Review a separately described mass-priced form.
liquids.risk: Volume implies neither density nor a pack conversion.

pieces.policy: Quote one named complete item or the single explicitly described roll.
pieces.alternative: Defer mixed packs or variable-width formats.
pieces.risk: The named item covers one synthetic presentation within a broader class.

specialist.policy: Use one fictional non-graded object and explicit synthetic budget bands.
specialist.alternative: Exclude if the fictional presentation is unsuitable.
specialist.risk: No valuation, grade, identity of maker, or authenticity is asserted.

unresolved_excluded.policy: Hold outside scope pending specific form and suitability decisions.
unresolved_excluded.alternative: Revisit later with an exact named item and independent proposed values.
unresolved_excluded.risk: Inclusion changes exact scope and coverage and requires a new review binding.
